content.text:
Nvidia, AMD, CoreWeave, Coherent, First Solar, Trade Desk, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Stocks rose Monday as an appetite for buying the dip outweighed a decline in Nvidia, which was pressured by an investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang.
